summary: A dispatch-pinned review report carries ship or no_ship and up to 64 ranked findings with closed severity and confidence. Oracle-bound findings classify delivery blockers, uncovered cases, follow-ups, and oracle defects, with source bindings and canonical event-sequence/ordinal lineage. Closed resolution claims name finding IDs and qualifying evidence. Ship refuses P0 or classified blockers; an outside-scope P0 follow-up remains retained no_ship without becoming repair debt. Recorded terminal results stay as recorded; no payload version, upcast, or replay reinterprets them. The shared context exposes reported content without granting workflow verdict or acceptance authority.
title: A review report carries a typed verdict and ranked findings
